description: Commercial Property Insurance Quote, Carrier Binder, Schedule of Values (SOV), or Named Windstorm / Schedule B Deductible Endorsement specifying layer limits, total insured value, annual premium, and peril deductibles. Where to read: Identified by "Commercial Property Quote", "Slip / Binder", "Schedule of Values (SOV)", or "Schedule B Named Windstorm Deductible Endorsement" headers on Pages 1-4 and 11. Distinguish from: Do NOT confuse with voluntary employee group benefits rate sheets (`benefits-quote`) or real estate loan credit agreements (`cre-credit-agreement`).

issuer.description: Underwriting carrier, Lloyd's syndicate, or managing general agent (MGA).

coverage_limit.description: Maximum primary or layer property coverage limit of liability. Where to read: Page 1-2 Declarations / Coverage Schedule ('Primary Layer Property Coverage Limit'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract Total Insured Value (TIV) from the SOV or sublimits for debris removal.

total_insured_value.description: 100% Total Insured Value (TIV) across scheduled locations in the Statement/Schedule of Values. Where to read: Schedule of Values (SOV) summary row (typically Page 11 or attached SOV schedule). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the carrier's Layer Coverage Limit (`coverage_limit`), which is often capped below TIV.

deductible.description: Applicable property peril deductible or self-insured retention, preferring the Schedule B Named Windstorm / Coastal Override when present for coastal placements. Where to read: Page 1 Deductible block ('All Other Perils Base Deductible') AND Page 4 Schedule B Endorsement ('Named Windstorm Deductible Override'); when a Schedule B coastal/wind endorsement is attached, extract the Schedule B override amount. Distinguish from: Do NOT extract waiting-period time deductibles (e.g. '72 hours') or superseded All-Other-Perils base deductibles when a Schedule B peril endorsement overrides them.

premium.description: Total annual policy or layer premium in the quote's currency. Where to read: Page 1-2 Premium Summary block ('Total Annual Premium'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract surplus lines stamping fees, terrorism (TRIA) optional add-ons, or broker commission.

currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code (e.g. USD, GBP, EUR). Where to read: Declarations header or monetary column header. Distinguish from: Normalize '$' to 'USD' and '£' to 'GBP'.

effective_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when policy coverage or endorsement takes effect. Where to read: Page 1 Policy Period block ('Effective Date' / 'Inception'). Distinguish from: Do NOT extract the Quote Issue Date or Policy Expiration Date.
